_readme: DOCUMENTATION — a human/agent-facing catalogue of chart anti-patterns and why the engine refuses them. No code loads this file back; most of the rules it lists are separately enforced in code the reader can check directly (adapters/echarts/validate.mjs's G-CHART/G-SIZE gates: pie-slice cap, zero-baseline bars, node cap, Sankey conservation; the graph builder's SSR-only layout restriction) — this file is the rationale companion to those gates, not itself a gate. Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084).

anti_patterns.rule: No 3D bars/pies — 3D only for genuine spatial/3-axis structure (docgen isometric3d owns document 2.5D)
anti_patterns.enforcement: no 3D route exists in this adapter; requests → NO_CHART or docgen
validator G-CHART requires zero baseline unless allow_negative deltas
validator G-SIZE caps nodes at 1500; catalog routes dense graphs to adjacency heatmap
validator G-CHART requires positive, endpoint-valid flows; catalog requires reconciliation
no builder emits a second y-axis

anti_patterns.rule: Color never the only critical signal
anti_patterns.enforcement: heatmap value labels default on; status presets label states; a11y decal available
T-R3 project law — scorecards show per-item status counts
graph builder allows circular/none/preset only — force is non-deterministic

anti_patterns.rule: No cloud-backed chart storage for internal data
anti_patterns.enforcement: engine is local-only; apache/echarts-mcp rejected on this ground (mcp/approved-server.json)

anti_patterns.rule: Motion only when it explains sequence/direction/change
anti_patterns.enforcement: SSR always static; interactive HTML ships a static fallback via prefers-reduced-motion/print

anti_patterns.rule: A hover or focus state never changes a mark's hue, never fills an open path, never moves a mark and never takes the pointer from it — brightness, outline, thickness and opacity only
anti_patterns.enforcement: the figure layer owns hover (adapters/echarts/figure-layer.mjs); tests/figure-layer.test.mjs 'hover law' fails any rule that recolours; docs/design/FIGURE_SYSTEM.md §4

anti_patterns.rule: No outline round a label, and never a fixed ink on a coloured fill — the label takes the near-black or white (pure black/white in the mid-tone band) that clears WCAG AA against its own fill
anti_patterns.enforcement: textBorderWidth 0 everywhere (NOHALO); adapters/echarts/contrast.mjs inkFor; tests/figure-layer.test.mjs 'labels carry no halo' and the contrast sweep

anti_patterns.rule: No anonymous dots: a scatter, bubble or timeline row has a name, a bubble says what its size measures, and a figure with numbered circles prints a key to them
anti_patterns.enforcement: data.names / data.notes / data.size_label with gate G-STRUCT (rows must correspond one to one); docgen prints the reading key and mark table under every figure

anti_patterns.rule: Severity and status words are never coloured by palette position (Critical is not blue because blue is slot 0; Low is blue in the Atlas scale)
anti_patterns.enforcement: adapters/echarts/semantic-colors.mjs applies the reserved colours by label; job.semantic_colors:false is the only opt-out

anti_patterns.rule: A figure is never written as if it were the only one on the page: no unscoped CSS, no unscoped ids, no class names shared between figures
anti_patterns.enforcement: every selector starts svg[data-fig=…]; every declared id and its references carry the figure scope (figure_support.scope_svg_ids, mirrored in the chart engine); docs/design/FIGURE_SYSTEM.md §3
